- **Window:** <start UTC> – <end UTC>
- **Expected impact:** <none/read-only/interruption and duration>
- **Change:** <release/change record link>
- **Rollback trigger and owner:** <measurable condition>

## Before

Announce at least 72 hours ahead, verify backup/restore evidence, freeze unrelated
changes, confirm approvers, and capture baseline health/SLOs.

## Updates

Post start, material delay, impact change, rollback, and completion timestamps.
Do not expose credentials, internal addresses, or attacker details.

## Completion

Record smoke/synthetic results, actual impact, follow-up owner, and the next
customer-facing update. Close only after monitoring returns to baseline.
